bullets.text: The US government is investigating a nationwide flight suspension caused by a copper wire upgrade, with officials questioning whether the chaos resulted from incompetence or faulty equipment.
Ukrainian President Zelensky claims the US has suggested Ukraine cede Donbas in exchange for Nato membership as part of efforts to end the war with Russia.
Italy has fined Meta €805 million, accusing the social media giant of failing to inform 20 million users that it had access to their photos.
Australia is facing criticism for its high rates of rheumatic heart disease, with global health leaders endorsing a plan to eradicate the illness.

Prime Minister Albanese is navigating the complexities of climate ambition and political realities at the UN climate change conference, aiming to establish Australia as a serious global climate player.
Families in Brisbane are rallying to prevent the closure of a long-standing daycare center in Acacia Ridge, which is scheduled to shut down by Christmas.

Sam Bankman-Fried, the jailed cryptocurrency mogul, missed out on a nearly $40 billion windfall from an early investment in the AI lab Anthropic, highlighting the financial consequences of his legal troubles.
Italy is considering an exit tax that would apply capital gains taxes to rich emigrants, a theoretical concept that faces practical challenges and is causing significant debate.
China's banking system is grappling with the aftermath of years of 'Wild East capitalism,' as indebted tycoons pose a significant challenge to the stability of lenders.
